reviews.title: Working Great!
reviews.body: This mobile desk was easy to assemble (eight screws with provided Allen wrench and four casters with provided wrench). The assembly instructions are clear, concise, and easy to follow. I have not had it long, but it is very sturdy and rolls easily (I have hardwood floors, but feel it would glide on carpet fairly easily also). I would describe it as a simple (not a lot of bells and whistles), solid and versatile desk. The pneumatic adjust works very smoothly and the desk stays at the position desired until you adjust it again. I like having the wide range of height adjustment. I can use it easily whether I am sitting or standing (I am 6 foot). Overall, I rate this mobile desk easily at 5 Stars due to the ease of assembly, solid and versatile characteristics, and smooth operation.
